cm_more.text: I'd like a friend with two eyes, and one more leg than eyes.

cm_fewer.text: Eight legs, please, and two fewer eyes than legs.

cm_not.text: Hmm. Count its eyes. Then one more leg?

cm_not_fewer.text: Hmm. Count its legs. Then two fewer eyes?

zd_intro.text: My beach is a giant number line! Pinch to zoom in, and tap the sand to dig.

zd_347.text: The treasure is at three hundred and forty-seven!

zd_805.text: The treasure is at eight hundred and five!

zd_half.text: Dig halfway between six hundred and seven hundred!

zd_r10.text: Round four hundred and eighty-two to the nearest ten. Dig there!

zd_r100.text: Which hundred is nearest to four hundred and eighty-two? Dig there!

zd_2_7.text: The treasure is at two point seven!

zd_6850.text: The treasure is at six thousand, eight hundred and fifty!

zd_0_36.text: The treasure is at zero point three six!

zd_r3_48.text: Round three point four eight to the nearest tenth. Dig there!

zd_cmp.text: Which is further along, zero point four five, or zero point five? Tap its flag!

zd_cmp_ans.text: Zero point five is the same as zero point five zero. It is further along!

zd_far.text: From up here, only the hundreds show.

zd_zoom.text: Zoom in closer to dig there.

zd_end.text: My treasure map! Look at all your treasure!

tp_intro.text: Welcome to my gem mine! Ten gems make a bar, and ten bars make a crate.

tp_intro9.text: Welcome to my gem mine! Ten crates make a chest. A chest holds a thousand gems!

tp_intro10.text: Welcome to my gem mine! Today we chip gems: ten chips make one gem.

tp_box9.text: Each box in my cart holds nine pieces, no more!

tp_full.text: That box is full! Squish ten into one bigger piece.

tp_pop.text: Put one big piece in the other funnel, and out come ten smaller ones!

tp_dig.text: I dug up lots of gems! Pack them all into my cart.

tp_bigdig.text: What a big dig! Pack it all into my cart.

tp_chips.text: I chipped lots of gems! Pack the chips into my cart.

tp_howmany.text: How many gems are in my cart?

tp_merge.text: Here comes another cart! Tip it into mine.

tp_inall.text: How many gems is that in all?

tp_count.text: Let us count it, the biggest pieces first.

tp_open.text: Not enough small pieces? Pop a big one open!

tp_236.text: Pom wants two hundred and thirty-six gems!

tp_305.text: Noodle wants three hundred and five gems!

tp_362.text: Mumba wants three hundred and sixty-two gems!

tp_2503.text: Bam wants two thousand, five hundred and three gems!

tp_4060.text: Fizz wants four thousand and sixty gems!

tp_give145.text: Fizz needs one hundred and forty-five gems from my cart. Put them in the basket!

tp_give350.text: Bim needs three hundred and fifty gems. Put them in the basket!

tp_give1_4.text: Mumba needs one point four gems. Put them in the basket!

tp_2_7.text: Pom wants two point seven gems!

tp_12_5.text: Noodle wants twelve point five gems!

tp_end.text: Look at all my carts! Thank you for packing!

tp_squish.text: Put ten in the squisher, and out comes one bigger piece!

pr_tip.text: Hmm, not quite. Have another look!

pr_quick.text: Now the quick ones! As fast as you can!

kc_intro.text: Race you! Every right answer is a boost!

kc_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots, then type.

kc_time.text: Time's up! Let's look at the board.

kc_win.text: You won! That was a great race!

kc_lose.text: That was close! Shall we race again?

kc_calm.text: We made it! What a race!

kc_jump.text: Three in a row! A big jump!

nl_intro.text: Hop in! Set the dials, pull the lever, and down we go!

nl_dial.text: Turn each wheel to make this floor. Then pull the lever!

nl_next.text: What floor comes next? Follow the steps down the shaft.

nl_back.text: We are counting back. What floor comes next?

nl_jump.text: Find the floor we land on. Put your number in, then tap OK.

nl_compare.text: Compare these floors. Choose greater than, equal to, or less than.

nl_pattern.text: Look at the room numbers in order. Which number is missing?

nl_longer.text: Both ropes start together. How much longer is the long rope?

nl_lineSet.text: Take the lift to this floor. Drag it, or tap the line. Then tap Stop here.

nl_lineRead.text: What floor is this? Look at the marks beside the lift.

nl_rollover.text: Tap the arrow above the tens. What happens when we add another ten?

nl_ten_more.text: One more ten! Watch the tens and the hundreds.

nl_how_many_tens.text: How many tens make a hundred?

nl_tensIn.text: Each hundred has a stack of ten bars. How many tens altogether?

nl_room_bed.text: The bedroom! Someone is having a snooze!

nl_room_bath.text: The bath room! So many bubbles!

nl_room_fossil.text: The fossil room! Look at those old bones!

nl_room_socks.text: The sock room! Phew, what a smell!

nl_look_hundreds.text: Look at the hundreds! Compare this floor with the floor we want.

nl_look_tens.text: Look at the tens! Compare this floor with the floor we want.

nl_look_ones.text: Look at the ones! Compare this floor with the floor we want.

nl_tip_next.text: Follow one more step of the same size. Watch the jump on the line.

nl_tip_jump.text: These jumps show the parts. Follow them along the line.

nl_tip_compare.text: Start at the biggest place. Find the first digits that are different.

nl_tip_equal.text: All the digits match. These floors are the same.

nl_tip_pattern.text: Look at the steps between the room numbers. Keep the same step.

nl_step.text: The same step each time! Follow the numbers from room to room.

nl_tip_longer.text: Start at the end of the short rope. Measure the extra bit.

nl_tip_set.text: This tag shows where you stopped. Compare it with the floor on the card.

nl_tip_read.text: Start at a numbered mark. Count the little steps to the lift.

nl_tip_tens.text: Count the bars in each stack. Each bar is one ten.

nl_tip_rollover.text: Look at the bars. A full hundred holds this many tens.

nl_no_tens.text: No tens. The zero keeps the tens place empty.

nl_watch.text: Watch with me. We will do it one step at a time.

nl_twin.text: Your turn again! Here is a fresh floor to find.

nl_end.text: Look at all the floors we found together!

mr_intro.text: My marble run! Drop a marble in a cup, and watch it roll.

mr_make.text: Make this number! Tap a cup to drop a marble. Then tap the tick.

mr_read.text: What number is in the cups?

mr_add.text: Add this many! Drop them in, then tap the tick.

mr_many.text: Tap Run for each number. Watch them join together!

mr_split.text: Why does it work? Tens with tens, ones with ones.

mr_order.text: I'll drop these two numbers. Then the other way round.

mr_order_same.text: The same! The order doesn't change it.

mr_how_many_tens.text: How many tens made one hundred?

mr_tens_in.text: How many tens are in these hundreds?

mr_tip_full.text: That cup's full. Ten tens would need the big cup!

mr_squish_ones.text: Ten ones squish into one ten!

mr_squish_tens.text: Ten tens squish into one hundred!

mr_tip_add.text: Look at the second number. How many tens? How many ones?

mr_twin.text: Your turn! Try a fresh number.

mr_end.text: What a run! Thanks for helping!

pp_intro.text: Parcels to deliver! Hop in, and let's find the doors.

pp_tip_next.text: One more each time. Look at the dots.

pp_first.text: This one is for the first house.

pp_second.text: This one is for the second house.

pp_third.text: This one is for the third house.

pp_tip_order.text: Let's start from the first door.

pp_deliver.text: A parcel for this number! Which door?

pp_tip_on.text: Not yet! The number we want is bigger. Drive on!

pp_tip_back.text: Too far! The number we want is smaller. Back up!

pp_blank.text: This plate fell off! What number goes here?

pp_before.text: What number is just before this door?

pp_tip_blank.text: Look at the doors on each side.

pp_one_more.text: The next door is one more.

pp_more.text: Which parcel has the bigger number? Tap it.

pp_less.text: Which parcel has the smaller number? Tap it.

pp_tip_compare.text: Look at the dots under each parcel.

pp_ten_more.text: The next street is ten more. Same door! What's its number?

pp_ten_less.text: The next street is ten less. Same door! What's its number?

pp_tip_tens.text: Only the tens change. The ones stay the same.

pp_side.text: Is this number odd or even?

pp_across.text: It's even! It goes across the road.

pp_tip_even.text: Even numbers end in zero, two, four, six or eight.

pp_sign.text: Which sign goes between these numbers?

pp_tip_digits.text: Look at the first digit that's different.

pp_set.text: Find this number on the road. Move the van, then press Stop here.

pp_read.text: What number is the van on?

pp_tip_read.text: Start at a labelled mark. Count along the little marks.

pp_twin.text: Here is a fresh parcel. Have a go!

pp_end.text: Every parcel found its door! Thank you!

ts_intro.text: Welcome to my shop! Friends are coming in.

ts_one.text: One coin for each! Tap a coin, or slide it to a spot.

ts_tip_one.text: Each treasure needs just one coin. Look for an empty spot.

ts_pay_n.text: The dots show the price. Put that many coins on the mat, then tap the tick.

ts_tip_more.text: Some dots still need a coin. Match a coin to each dot.

ts_too_many.text: That is too much. These coins come back. Have another go.

ts_same.text: Find a coin that looks the same. Tap it.

ts_same_or_not.text: Do these coins look the same, or different? Tap your choice.

ts_know_pick.text: Look at the value on the card. Which coin has that value?

ts_know_name.text: Look at this coin. Tap the tag that tells its value.

ts_how_much.text: How much altogether? Count the coins, then use the number pad.

ts_how_many.text: How many of this coin make the amount on the card?

ts_mixed.text: How much altogether? Start with the biggest value.

ts_pay.text: Pay this much. Tap coins and notes, or slide them to the mat, then tap Pay. Tap one on the mat to take it back.

ts_order.text: Add the prices of these treasures. How much altogether?

ts_change.text: Our friend paid with this note. How much change? Count up from the price.

ts_story.text: Listen to the story. Read it with me. Show your answer on the number pad.

ts_sort.text: Put flat things on the flat shelf, and solid things on the solid shelf. Tap a thing, then its shelf, or slide it there.

ts_build.text: Copy my toy tower. Start at the bottom. Tap a piece, or slide it to the mat.

ts_faces.text: How many flat faces does it have? Tap the number.

ts_corners.text: How many corners does it have? Tap the number.

ts_edges.text: How many edges does it have? Tap the number.

ts_every.text: Tap every cube. Then tap the tick.

ts_graph_count.text: Look at the treasures on the card. How many did we sell?

ts_graph_more.text: Look at the two treasures on the card. How many more of the first did we sell?

ts_graph_most.text: Which treasure did we sell the most of? Tap its stack.

ts_tip_count.text: Count on by each coin's value. The little tags will help.

ts_tip_match.text: Look closely at the size, the edge and the number. Compare them with the card.

ts_tip_sort.text: A flat thing is thin. A solid takes up space. Look at the shelf pictures.

ts_tip_build.text: Look at the next piece in the picture. Build from the bottom up.

ts_tip_faces.text: Let's look all around it. Watch each part, then look at the opened shape.

ts_tip_graph.text: Line up the shorter stack. Count just the extra blocks above it.

ts_tip_change.text: Jump up to the next ten, then on to the note. Add the jumps.

ts_tip_story.text: Let's act it out slowly. Watch what comes in and what goes away.

ts_show.text: Watch me work it out, one step at a time.

ts_twin.text: Now try a fresh one like that. Take your time.

ts_yes.text: That works! Our friend is happy.

ts_end.text: Closing time! Look what we sold today. Thanks for helping in my shop!

ts_flat.text: I'd like the flat one. Tap it.

ts_solid_ball.text: I'd like the ball. Tap it.

ts_solid_box.text: I'd like the box. Tap it.

ts_solid_can.text: I'd like the can. Tap it.

ts_solid_cube.text: I'd like the cube. Tap it.

ts_solid_cone.text: I'd like the cone. Tap it.

ts_solid_cylinder.text: I'd like the cylinder. Tap it.

ts_solid_sphere.text: I'd like the sphere. Tap it.

ts_solid_pyramid.text: I'd like the pyramid. Tap it.

ts_tip_short.text: Not quite enough yet. Look how much more we need.
